reasoning: This Phase I trial was terminated early due to 'prioritization of other pipeline assets' with only 1 patient enrolled. The investigator noted no safety or efficacy issues were observed, but with n=1 and early termination, no meaningful assessment of the causal chain is possible. The target and mechanism are unclear, no target engagement data exists, no biomarker changes were measured, and no clinical endpoints were evaluated. This represents a commercial decision to halt development rather than a scientific failure of the mechanism.
